name: world
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production VELDRYN mobile fantasy RPG UI icon, isolated on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. Premium hand-crafted pixel-art illustration with clean deliberate pixel clusters, strong readable silhouette at 32 px, moderate detail, consistent upper-left lighting, restrained bevel depth. Material palette strictly warm aged bronze (#76512d, #b18445, #d2aa63), very dark navy/charcoal (#101a27, #203347) and restrained blue crystal (#397995, #70b8cb). Dark navy edge shading, no external stroke. No white, off-white, silver, ivory highlights, no pale fringe, no sticker outline, no glow, no drop shadow outside the silhouette, no background rectangle, no surrounding badge/frame unless the object itself requires one. Centered object fills about 80% of a square image, fully visible with clear transparent gutters. Flat frontal icon composition, consistent material rendering; not emoji, not photorealistic, no text, numbers, letters, watermark, extra symbols or ornament confetti. Final exported icon must look polished on both dark and light backgrounds. Render as a carefully shaded high-quality game sprite, not thin outline art. The transparent pixels must be genuine alpha, not a painted checkerboard.
Subject: WORLD icon. A bold four-point bronze explorer's compass with an inset deep navy face and a single faceted blue crystal needle pointing northeast. Compact, readable, symmetrical main body, warm bronze highlights only. No letter labels. This is the master style reference for the whole navigation family.
